description: This file contains unit tests for DataElement and DataStore classes, as well as LinkedDataElement and DataElementParser, verifying their functionality in handling data buffers, copying, CRC checks, and parsing operations.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with buffer management, CRC, search, and manipulation functions.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: Manages a buffer of data with copy and size management capabilities.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Implements linked data elements with encapsulation of other data elements.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Parses and validates data within a DataElement.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the DataStore or DataElement.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the size of the data buffer.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the data object is valid.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number within the data using endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number at a specific position with endianness.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number from the data at a specific position.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Performs a search for a sequence within the data.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets bits within a number at specified positions.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves bits within a number at specified positions.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specified offset in the data.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns data to a boundary based on type.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Returns the enclosed data element if any.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of linked data.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the number of linked elements.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Skips specified number of bytes in parsing.
